info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Gateway Payment Update API
info.description: The Financial Gateway Payment Update API allows users to modify existing payment details within the financial gateway system. This operation is essential for resolving discrepancies, updating transaction statuses, or adjusting payment parameters as needed. Targeted primarily at financial institutions and payment processors, this API facilitates efficient management of financial transactions. Developers can leverage this endpoint to enhance user experiences by ensuring accurate and up-to-date payment information.

patch.summary: Update payment information for the specified financial gateway resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update specific details of the payment linked to the financial gateway resource with ID RES-100045. You can specify the fields you wish to modify in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update payment information for the specified financial gateway. It contains the necessary details required for the PATCH operation, ensuring that the requested modifications are accurately applied.
